ingredients.title: Beef
items: 1 lb beef top round steak (3/4 inch thick)

ingredients.title: Vegetables
items: 2 cups fresh asparagus pieces or fresh broccoli florets
1 small sweet red or green pepper, julienned
In a large resealable plastic bag, combine the cornstarch, 2 Tbsp water, salt, pepper and hot pepper sauce; add the beef. Seal bag and turn to coat.
In a large skillet or wok, stir-fry half of the beef in 1 Tbsp oil until no longer pink; remove from the skillet and keep warm. Repeat with remaining beef and 1 Tbsp oil.
Stir-fry the asparagus and cauliflower in remaining oil for 4 minutes.
Add red pepper and onion; stir-fry for 2 minutes. Return beef to skillet.
In a small bowl, combine the bouillon, soy sauce, ketchup, vinegar, sugar and remaining water; add to the skillet.
Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until heated through. Serve with rice.
